articles.summary: A 27-year-old Brampton man is facing half a dozen charges in connection with a series of attempted carjackings and a stabbing last weekend. Police in Peel Region say a man attempted to steal a car with the owner seated inside near the area of Clockwork Drive and Creditview Road just after 10 p.m. on Sept. […]

articles.title: Reliance on visual inspections may have played role in GO train derailment at Union Station: report
articles.summary: A new report has found an overreliance on visual inspections of the train tracks may have contributed to the derailment of a GO Transit train at Toronto's Union Station that disrupted commuter travel for days earlier this year.

articles.title: 1 injured in Jane and Finch shooting
articles.summary: One man is recovering in hospital after being shot in North York on Friday afternoon. Toronto police were called to the Finch Avenue West and Driftwood Avenue area just before 3:45 p.m. for reports of a shooting. Officers located a man who was transported to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. No suspect description was immediately available.

articles.title: Stellantis signs MOU with Canadian armoured vehicle maker on potential sale of Brampton, Ont., plant
articles.summary: Automaker Stellantis says it has signed a memorandum of understanding with Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel on a potential sale of its idled Brampton, Ont., assembly plant.

articles.title: Overreliance on visual inspections may have contributed to GO train derailment: report
articles.summary: TORONTO — A new report has found an overreliance on visual inspections of the train tracks may have contributed to the derailment of a GO Transit train at Toronto’s Union Station that disrupted commuter travel for days earlier this year.

articles.title: 'Destruction is not necessary': Gardeners fight city plan to relocate 30-year-old community plot
articles.summary: A 30-year-old community garden in downtown Toronto will soon have to pull up its stakes and move, as the city prepares to transform a piece of land into an eight-storey supportive housing project.

articles.title: Streaming fatigue? Inside the new Criterion retail store in Toronto
articles.summary: A massive selection of DVD, Blu-ray, and 4K physical movies lining every wall has opened in Toronto, curated by Criterion Collection, a film company based in New York. CBC’s Mercedes Gaztambide takes you inside its first retail store in the city.

articles.title: Brad Bradford says he will put a Toronto police outpost in Union Station if he’s elected mayor
articles.summary: Brad Bradford has promised a Toronto police outpost at Union Station as part of his mayoral campaign platform.
